risks.risk: Wrong camera model (seller says D750 but photos don’t confirm the exact model).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera showing the model name (e.g., on the top/bottom plate) or the 'About/Model' screen after powering on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unconfirmed Nikon DSLR body (worst case: not the claimed D750).

risks.risk: Not actually working (faulty shutter, dead sensor, broken buttons/ports).
risks.proof: Short video: power on → menu navigation → take a photo → playback image; also show autofocus working on a nearby object.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs testing/possible faults).

risks.proof: Screenshot/photo from a shutter count tool or the exact shutter count readout shown on-screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as higher shutter wear (worst case: not under 5,000).

risks.risk: Lens issues (fungus, haze, scratches) not visible from the current angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lens elements at multiple angles with strong light (front and rear glass), plus a test shot showing contrast/flare.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lens condition uncertain (worst case: possible fungus/haze/scratches).

risks.risk: Battery/charger may be non-original or missing.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the battery label and charger label/model; show they are included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming accessories may be generic or incomplete.

risks.risk: Damage from shipping/handling (carton wear; bubble wrap present but no confirmation of internal condition).
risks.proof: Photos of the camera body corners, mount area, and any dents; plus a functional test (ports, hot shoe, lens mount).

proof_requests: Power-on video showing: menu, taking a photo, and playback (with date/time visible).
A screenshot/photo of shutter count readout.
Close-up lens photos: front element and rear element (rear glass via mount side) under bright light at angles.
Clear photo of the camera model name/label (to confirm D750) and serial number area.
Photos of included battery and charger labels (to confirm originality) and that they are present.
response.reason: The photos show a Nikon DSLR setup in boxes, but they do not clearly confirm the exact model (D750) or verify key claims like shutter count, working status, and lens condition. Without those decisive proofs, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
